technical.summary: Strong technical confluence with price above all major MAs, bullish momentum indicators, and new highs, but overbought RSI/Stoch conditions and weak ADX trend strength limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: DLTR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 45 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling pressure combined with market fear (33 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy setup, though lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (417.6) with flat yield curve and imminent CPI event create hostile macro conditions; earnings in 45 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical confluence (price above all MAs, three white soldiers, new highs, Hull flip bullish) with contrarian buy signal in fear-zone market creates tactical swing entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI 71.45 and Stoch 82.77 without bullish cross, weak ADX 22.11 trend strength, zero fundamental conviction, hostile macro (VIX crisis 417.6, flat yield curve, imminent CPI), and earnings risk within 45 days make risk/reward unfavorable for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows strong confluence (price above MAs, three white soldiers, new highs) with contrarian buy signal in fear zone, but overbought RSI/Stoch conditions and weak trend strength (ADX 22.11) severely limit swing probability.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis 417.6, flat yield curve, imminent CPI event) combined with overbought technicals and earnings risk in 45 days create hostile risk/reward with high pullback probability.
